title: KILLALL FASTKILL RAGE VISUALS AIMBOT LEGIT (*NO KEY*)

Aimbot - Smooth camera lock with FOV circle

Triggerbot - Auto-fire the moment your crosshair touches an enemy

Anti-Aim - Fake yaw and pitch with visible head tilt
